items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: And those were the alto players -- neither one of those guys could play good at the first alto player... Chauncey Haughton came back.

ctx.x: See, he was playing baritone. So actually he was playing second alto. And Pete Clark must've been playing first, because Hilton Jefferson came back -- Chauncey Haughton came back. And those were the alto players -- neither one of those guys could play good at the first alto player, (inaudible) good alto player. Jordan was a good alto player, but he wasn't a good first man.
